notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon is featured in the Tiny Teams festival!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We hope you've been having fun with the demo so far!

Furcifer's Fungeon is featured in the Tiny Teams festival which will be running from now through to August 10th and will feature a whole host of other games made by Tiny Teams!

 Check out the Tiny Teams page here! 


- Dorothea & Mario

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.6.1 (Demo)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while since the last patch - we have been working on a lot of stuff behind the scenes (Full version content, translations). We got 4 new Darkness items for you to try out. To find them, enable Rotating Demo Content in the in-game options. 

The biggest change in this update is the Block rework. Block used to be based on the Block chance stat. Now, shields can generate a Block Token that will shield you from exactly the next hit. Shields generate Block tokens in various ways. Let us know how you like this change and the different shields!

Full Changelog 0.6.1:

New Features:

 “Block” now works based on block tokens that are generated by your shield. All shields and block chance talents are changed to account for this!
 Added “Dodge on Hit” chance behaving similarly to the old block, but triggering “On Dodge” effects
 Rotated out Faraday’s Chainmail, Helmholtz Helm and Zeus’ Thunderpants
 Rotated in Grand Lich’s Kneecap, Grand Lich’s Skull, Grand Lich’s Bone Feet and Grand Lich’s Soul!

Balance:
Wands

 Impractically Large Greatsword now contests enemy projectiles
 Improved Ball Lightning handling

Talents

 Samael’s Final Form: Increased AOE and Damage (100 -> 120)

Fixes:

 Fixed enemies being able to survive out of screen
 Fixed ice blocks sometimes not spawning the the enemy was oneshot
 Sparkies now face in the correct direction
 Fixed a translation issue with “Fire”

Visuals & other changes:

 Dash indicator is now under the player character’s feet
 Improved talent layouting
 Remade Firemaw & Icemaw VFX
 Performance Optimisations
 Unified many fonts
 Ball Lightning now has screen shake
 Iceblocks now flash when kicked
 Added 0.33x resolution scaling

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.6.0 (Demo)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Today we released patch 0.6.0 for the demo, marking a major version!
The demo has been progressing very nicely, to a point that we start to plan for the final release. So at some point, we need to have actual full version exclusive content. We thought about that for a while and think we found the coolest way to do it:
We will make large portions of items, talents etc. available in a rotation for several weeks. This way, you can take a look at it, test it and give feedback. 

This patch is centered around 2 things: 
1) We vastly improved controller support, making it almost feature-complete. 
2) We introduced new content, some permanent and some of it rotating.

Here are the full patch notes for version 0.6.0:
New Features:

6 NEW TALENTS:
 Ice Blocks, Shatter, Azrael’s Ice Demise, Azrael's Final Form, Samael’s Eternal Infernal Burnal, Samael's Final Form

FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT:
 Any number of controllers can be used and switched on the fly - you don’t need to change it in the options
 Added button rebinding for controller
 Now shows correct (and controller type dependent) button prompts
 ADDED CONTROLLER VIBRATION - Can be adjusted in the options
 Added deadzone configuration for both sticks
 Players 1 and 2 can now both play with a controller

ROTATING CONTENT:
 Added rotating content for the demo, that will only be accessible temporarily for testing (and of course included in the full version). They can be enabled in the options. Temporary items can not be added to the collection. Please help us test this content!
 This version includes preview versions of the missing Electricity set items and two Electricity talents

OPPORTUNITY TALENTS:
 Added Opportunity talents, that are only offered once per run. Some talents are Opportunities now. Let us know how you like them, they are an experiment.

ACCESSIBILITY OPTIONS:
 You can now keybind switching to one specific wand
 You can now keybind the 4 individual attacks to keys and the wand switches automatically (this should offer an alternative way to cast that makes it easier to keep track of the current wand)
 Added autoaiming options: off, assisted (you can influence aiming, but it snaps), full
 Added an autofire toggle button

Balance:
General

 Poison now ticks half as fast, but for twice the damage per tick
 Burn now ticks half as fast, but for twice the damage per tick

Wands

 Sun Strike: Reduced delay from 0.8 to 0.3
 Firebolt: Improved trajectory to converge earlier

Talents

 Thermite now requires a Fire item instead of a Neutral item

Items

 Increased Scale Mail Cold resistance 20% -> 20/30/40 %

Dashes

 All dashes now reset the player knockback

Modules

 Reduced the speed of the fast scrolling conveyor belt module

Fixes:

 Fixed wand switch not being buffered while charging
 Fixed Dark fire kills not being counted
 Fixed a crash related to electrified water after multiple runs
 Fixed Spell areas being shown for a moment after the player spawns
 Fixed Menu-cursor mode activating after player 2 logged off
 Fixed upgrades being pickable through the stats screen with keyboard or controller
 Fixed a crash with p2 switching character and the damage meter

Visuals & minor changes:

 Thermite now changes the burn visual
 Deep Freeze now changes the ice visuals
 Made screen wide heal particles more responsive

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.6 (Demo)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This is one of our largest content patches so far, bringing a bunch of new enemies, reworked patterns and new Dungeon modules. We also added an Easter egg themed talent. We wish you a Happy Easter!
If you want to find out more about the new baddies (such as their elemental vulnerabilities), take a look at the Monster Manual (from the inventory or the title screen) :)

Here's the full changelog for 0.5.6:

New Features:

 REWORKED enemy patterns: Mushroom mobs, Bees and Slime Spawns
 NEW enemies: Black Knight, Black Mage, Black Bolt, Spooker and Sparky
 Added seasonal “Bunny Eggs” talent
 Added 9 new Dungeon modules

Fixes:

 Fixed a crash when water was placed in the first frame of a new run
 Fixed a crash caused by Honking Heal
 Fixed mushrooms waking up instantly without taking damage
 Fixed area indicator building unnecessary shapes in the background
 Fixed a crash when the waterfall was dried out because of the heat modifier
 Fixed an issue where projectiles could get weirdly large
 Fixed the Frozen region mod name being broken
 Ball lightning can no longer spawn inside objects
 Fixed player being unable to cast when hovering over the healthbar
 Fixed secondary wand popping in at the start of a run
 Fixed blue flame popping away for a few frames after launch

Balance:
General

 Adjusted enemy spawn rate, damage, movespeed and health, fungeon scroll speed scaling
 Spiderwebs now work differently

Wands

 Ball Lightning: damage 90 -> 100
 Detonate Ball Lightning: damage per tick 30 -> 40
 Blue Flame: charge duration increased by 10%

Visuals & minor changes:

 Added mushroom wakeup animation
 Conflagration: Changed fire projectiles to look less dangerous for you
 Reduced heal-particle amount
 Reduced Fire-floor particle amount
 Adjusted vignette effect
 Adjusted torch particle system (sparks)
 Lifesteal visual effect is now based on relative amount healed. It now only shows the effect when health was missing.
 Reduced firewall particle amount

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.5 (Demo)
notes.content:
Patch 0.5.5 for Furcifer's Fungeon is here! We added a feature that was requested a lot: a monster book where you can find out details about the Fungeon's fauna. It also counts how often you have defeated any type of monster, and shows their elemental vulnerabilities! 

The Frightening Frog, for example, is weak to Fire and Electricity, but resilient against Cold attacks. Cold? Yes, we have renamed Water to Cold, as it's a better representation! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006253/503db32bdf3925e7fa1f0d171ef4da407f8cff0f.png

Anyway, check out the details in the full changelog for 0.5.5:

New Features:

 Added a MONSTER MANUAL (accessible from title screen and inventory)
 Also added monster-specific elemental vulnerabilities!
 Effective/Ineffective damage is now shown next to the damage number (see Options to turn all damage numbers on)
 Enemies now can deal elemental damage by contact, which should make elemental resistances more useful!
 Damage numbers are now colored based on their element

Fixes:

 Fixed “The Grind” stat bonus not being applied
 Fixed background elements being hoverable through the levelup screen
 Fixed floor color changes being dragged to where they should not be
 Fixed Tim the Scarecrow using the power level of the previous run, making him weirdly strong sometimes
 Fixed “Lumberjack” sometimes spawning coins offscreen when the tree is at the bottom
 Fixed “Flash Friends” only applying the player’s crit/crit damage for 2s while the speed buff lasted (let us keep an eye on the balance impacts of this fix!)
 Prevented skeletons from standing inside enemies
 Fixed a crash related to the Cloud hitting stuff it really should not
 Fixed a crash when closing the Fungeon Report with 2 players
 Damage done by player 2 is now shown in the damage meter
 Fixed “Heat Disposal” not being accessible through “Hammer Juggling”
 Fixed tutorial slimes and Cactor sometimes levitating
 Game now ignores the first click when the window was not in focus

Balance:
Talents

 Reduced “Lumberjack” coin chance to 50% (compensating for the coin value change last patch)
 “Consume Friends” now requires “Shared Blood”
 “Necromastery” now requires “Undead Horde”
 Reduced “Necromastery” requirements from 100 to 50 skeleton kills
 “Flash Friends” now gives +20% skeleton movespeed permanently

Wands

 Blue Orb charge time increased by 10%
 Dragon now pierces up to 2 weak targets
 Player 2 now gains dash damage, critical hit chance, and critical damage with each character level


Visuals & minor changes:

 Changed “Water” element to “Cold” to work better with the item set and coming content
 Improved Bee and Big Bee animations
 Improved enemy animations, especially jumps are less janky now
 Improved enemy hit feedback
 Added unique particles for items of each element, also improved the sparks
 Marked the area to pray to the furcifer statue with a glow
 Player is now forced to take an item once, so new players cannot miss it ……
 Damage number direction now works better for strong enemies and late game
 Improved German localization
 Increased click area to enter the fungeon and now also highlight the portal, portal also expands now
 Wands that are not yet unlocked are now shown as a black silhouette

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.4 (Demo)
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we finished another update for the demo! The big new features this time are floor mods that change up the environment and enemies, and a German localization!

With the mods we hope to make your runs a bit more varied and challenging. We want to add a lot more different mods in the future. Let us know how you like them.

The German translation was done by us. Our publisher IndieArk is translating the game (including the demo) into several Asian languages. If you want to help localizing the game to other languages, send us a DM on Discord! 

Here's the full changelog for 0.5.4:

New Features:

 Added FLOOR MODS, random modifications to floors, like a frozen Forest (currently 3 major and 3 minor mods that are assigned randomly)
 Added a german localization!
 Localization can now be picked in options
 Added a Furcifer statue you can pray to in item rooms - it heals you and opens the hands
 Several behind-the-scenes improvements to the layout of tooltips
 Reduced the number of coins dropped, and equally reduced the amount of exp needed. This will reduce scores overall, don’t worry about them being lower

Fixes:

 Fixed personal high score not being saved when not buying an item and immediately quitting the game
 Fixed a crash related to the quest-finish message

Balance:
General

 Increased number of enchanted enemies late game
 Allowed enchanted common enemies in very late floors
 Last floor now kills you even more aggressively, you just keep finding ways…!
 Reduced the movement speed scaling on enemies

Characters

 Sir Honkalot dash damage 100 -> 120

Spells

 Charged Flame: damage 130 -> 110, kockback 500 -> 450
 Wave: cooldown 0.9 -> 0.8
 Gun (left click): damage 30 -> 40, reduced the effectiveness of mashing the shoot button with the gun
 Shotgun: bullets 10 -> 9
 Venom Tooth: damage 60 -> 70

Visuals & minor changes:

 Improved line spacing in tooltips
 Added a hint for the talent tree on the levelup screen
 Added a hint that you can view player builds in the leaderboard
 Adjusted Fireball light effect
 Added a glow to “Enter Fungeon” sign to make it look more interactive
 Reduced the amount of lifesteal particles
 Improved charge animation
 Made difficulty based colors less intense
 Conflagration projectiles now move faster with the same distance
 Adjusted burn particle amount
 Reduced hyperspeed particles
 Slightly adjusted tooltip size
 Added drop shadow to tooltips
 Improved shockhands vfx
 Improved lightning strike vfx
 Telegraphs now fade out faster

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.3 (Demo)
notes.content:
Furcifer wishes you a happy Valentine's Day! For this occasion, we added a new seasonal talent, "Sweetheart"! 💝

Last week, we've been busy bringing our other game, Super Kill-BOI 9000 to Steam Next Fest. The demo is still up, so check it out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126400/Super_KillBOI_9000/

We wanted to give you new content, so we added three more talents. One of them gives you talent rerolls. We're excited to hear what you think about it! Here's the full changelog for version 0.5.3:

New Features:

 NEW TALENTS: “Sweetheart”, “Lumberjack”, “Levitate”, and “Questing Adventurer”

Fixes:

 Fixed a tooltip remaining on screen after viewing the talent tree
 Fixed visual glitch when Wilhelm’s Portal was active when you die
 Fixed hyperspeed-particles remaining on screen after death
 Fixed Anger not shooting when holding down spells like gun/sword

Balance:

Items

 Dragon Tail: damage 40 -> 50

Spells

 Whirlwind damage 70 -> 75
 Fireball damage 35 -> 38
 Firebolt damage 30 -> 33
 Sword (Swing&Throw) damage 40 -> 42
 Fire Orb (now Charged Flame) damage 140 -> 130
 Thunder Slash damage 55 -> 50

Talents

 Anger: Attack speed 15% -> 10%
 Denial: Block 30% -> 25%
 Heat Disposal: Explosion damage 30 -> 60

Visuals & minor changes:

 Added many text keywords
 Some optimization
 Improved enemy damage-taken indicator

Improved description texts:

 Lifesteal is now rounded to 0.1 instead of 1
 Fixed Squire requirements being displayed as 150 contact damage, while being only 100 (it’s 150.)

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.2 (Demo)
notes.content:
Hey folks, we already have another nice little patch ready for you! This one focuses on quality of life and stability. We fixed some causes for crashes, and an option to enable a software cursor for those whose ingame cursor was invisible. Let us know if it helped!

Here's the full changelog for version 0.5.2:

New Features:

 Character sheet can now be opened from the Fungeon Report by pressing Escape
 Added option for software cursor (useful to fix cursor problems)
 Added option for the dash mode
 Added more resolution scaling options
 The damage dealt by electrified water now is now has damage numbers and scales with the players electricity damage and effect damage

Fixes:

 Fixed a crash when switching away from Fire Orb wand rapidly
 Fixed talent viewer showing wrong colors after playing a round
 Fixed a crash when you died while finishing a quest
 Fixed a softlock when leveling in the same frame you die

Balancing:
General

 Reduced late game boss hp scaling
 Adjusted late game exp bonus and lifesteal effectivity

Talents

 Necromastery: reduced requirements from 150 to 100 kills

Spells

 Reduced Fire Orb and Thunder Blade damage and knockback by 15%
 Increased Ball Lightning damage 80 -> 90
 Reduced Wave cooldown 1.0 -> 0.9

Other:

 Gave the character selection a visual overhaul
 Some optimization

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.1 (Demo)
notes.content:
Since the 0.5.0 update a lot of new players have played the demo, and we have received lots of feedback - thank you guys!
In this patch, we added a much requested feature: a talent viewer! It allows you to see what talents there are and what is currently in the talent pool. It should also give you a feeling for how much more content there is to come ;)

We also added three new talents, and some other awesome stuff! Check out the full patch notes below:

New Features:

 The complete talent tree can now be viewed ingame. It marks which ones you have seen and picked. Within the run, you see which ones you have chosen and which ones you have the requirements for.
 NEW CHARACTER TALENTS: “Feathers of Justice”, “Yoink!” and “Time Warp”
 Trees can now be killed (they are really tanky earlygame tho)
 The player can no longer be squeezed to death by the screen border, instead, Furcifer will save you
 Dash can now be bound to the mouse
 Mouse4 and Mouse5 buttons can now be used for key bindings

Fixes:

 Fixed Detonate Ball Lightning explosion sometimes not hitting targets 
 Fixed damage numbers moving weird on some systems and when vsync was off
 Fixed dash cooldown digits being cut after “.”
 Fixed Rage-Flames coming after closing the chest even when not stealing when you still had rage left over
 Fixed talents rounding their parameters, leading to inaccurate display (such as Gold Conductor duration being 0.25 but displayed as 0.3)
 Fixed “Quest complete” marker not being paused when the game pauses
 Fixed that fungeon color grading could be dragged into menus
 Fixed paw cursor being offset

Balance:

General

 Reduced Dark Fire (boss) hp by 10%
 Reduced chance of encountering Dark Fire from 30% to 20% per dungeon
 Increased Wilhelm base Intelligence by 2
 Increased the amount of bonus stats player 2 gets
 Reduced item quality bonus from Luck from 2% -> 1%
 Added a bonus to item quality based on how deep you are in the fungeon (goal is to make it more possible to find high-level items without stacking massive amounts of Luck while keeping Luck relevant)
 Slightly reduced the chance of temporal buffs dropping
 Increased shop item price by 10%
 Death floor is now slightly harder, “THE END” is now slightly easier

Spells

 Ball Lightning: damage 60 -> 80
 Wave: damage per tick 27 -> 30
 Sunstrike: cooldown 1.0 -> 0.9
 Whirlwind: damage 65 -> 70
 Venom Tooth: impact damage 50 -> 60
 Thunder Slash: damage 70 -> 65, Knockback 330 -> 300
 Magician: damage 170 -> 190
 Fire Orb: damage reduced 180 -> 160
 Gun: Accuracy increased (30° spread -> 15°)

Dashes

 Increased dash damage overall by 10%
 Increased Sir Honkalot’s feathers' projectile clearing capabilities

Items

 Cooling Gloves: no longer have a range restriction, reduced chance
 Fire Maw: damage +10

Talents

 Reduced level requirements for character-specific talents to 4 and 8 (from 5 and 10)
 Soul of the Badger: requires 25 Luck now, to be consistent with the other stat-based talents
 Zop: removed the +10 damage
 Epic Invulnerability: time 0.3s -> 0.2s
 Burnie: base damage 60 -> 55
 Anger: flame damage 20 -> 40
 Bargaining: exp gain 15 -> 10
 Thunder God: now needs 100 damage to complete, down from 150. Gives additional 50 damage as the completion reward
 Growing Armor is now considered a quest
 Ice Breath: damage 60 -> 120

Descriptions:

 Added hoverable keywords for globe pickups
 Improved descriptions for Dark Mage, Knight, experience gain, pickup amount

Visuals/minor improvements:

 Shotgun Blast: gun now shakes while charging
 Quests now have a mark showing if they are still progressing or done
 Made the color grading in later floors less intense
 Furcifer’s rage flames now pause when the game pauses
 Talent icons now react to hover
 Made it easier to hover stats in the tooltips
 Increased numbers of scores viewable in the leaderboard from 30 to 50

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.0 (Demo)
notes.content:
​This patch adds the game's first guest character and its first boss fight!
We hope you enjoy the new content. And let us know what other characters you would like to see added to Furcifer's Fungeon.

Of course, we improved a lot of stuff too!
Here's the full changelog for 0.5.0:

New Features:

 Added Fire from Her Name Was Fire as PLAYABLE CHARACTER and the first BOSSFIGHT, coming with 2 complete spellsets
 Furcifer now has a unique text line for each legendary trinket you steal

Fixes:

 Fixed a music hickup
 Fixed an error caused by the leaderboard being deleted and not happy with that

Balance:
General

 Effect damage bonus per point of int 1.5% -> 1%
 Contact damage per point of str 3 -> 2.5

Spells

 Rolling Stone: cooldown 1.6 -> 2.0
 Lightning Strike: Adjusted knockback direction

Dashes

 Reduced Britta’s dash startup
 Increase Britta dash damage 100 -> 120
 Incresead Britta dash cooldown 2.5s -> 3s
 Sir Honkalot’s dash knockback now is more to the sides
 Wilhelm’s dash base cooldown 3.5 -> 3

Items

 Dragon Tail: flame damage 20 -> 30
 Fire Maw: damage 70 -> 85
 Melting Feet: speed bonus from 25% -> 20%
 Ampere’s Gauntlets: movespeed bonus 20% -> 15%
 Maxwell Boots: movespeed bonus 30% -> 25%
 Charcoal Tablets regen 1 hp/s -> 3 hp/s
 Personal Defense Poop: Replaced contact damage with +10% nature damage
 Sneakers of Speed: speed bonus 20% -> 15%
 Vampire Fangs: lifesteal 2% -> 1%

Talents

 Gold Conductor: duration 0.3s -> 0.25s
 Adventurer: heal 100% -> 50%
 Critical Devastation: reduced from 30% for 2s to 25% for 1s
 Dragon Speed: speed bonus 20% -> 15%
 Dragon Hunger: lifesteal 3% -> 2%
 Critical Zap: cooldown 1s -> 2.5s
 Conductive Research: now has a per-target cooldown instead of a global one, cooldown 1s -> 2.5s
 Zop: no longer needs Thunder God to be compled before becoming accessible
 Thunder God: now stacks up to 150 damage
 Berserk: movespeed 30% -> 20%

Descriptions:

 Added damage and cooldown info to dashes
 Several grammatical improvements (thanks Eerywax and Nerve Atk for the proof read!)
 Added an info popup to make sure the player learns to hover stats

Visuals/minor improvements:

 Difficulty levels are now visually different
 Added a bit of vignette (experimental)
 Britta’s dash is a bit brighter
 Rolling Stone has a bit less shadow now
 Slightly reduced pitch variation of Furcifer’s voice
 Optimized CRT shader
 You now always collect hp potions even when you are full health

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.10 (Demo)
notes.content:
This patch brings the game's first familiar, Burnie the Fire Dragon! You can unlock him when you have at least two fire items and choose his talent. You can pick "Dragon Hoard" to make him grow (and happy)!
We also rebalanced and polished some things.

Here's the full Changelog for 0.4.10:

New Features:

 Replaced Dragon/Steel Dragon with Burnie/Dragon Hoard talent, that now actually gives you a dragon friend!
 Added Trinket prefix “Weighted”, adding 15kg weight
 Tutorial now rewards players with Thor’s Hammer instead of a Plate Mail

Fixes:

 Leaderboard run cards: primary stats no longer overflow when they go beyond 255 (you guys keep doing stuff!), they are now capped at 512
 Attempted to fix the flickering coins in levelup screen on some hardware (If you had this bug, or still have it, let us know!)

Balance:
General

 Reduced Skeleton base damage 60 -> 40
 Increased Skeleton base hp 350 -> 400
 Reduced powerup-globe chance by about 25%
 Slightly reduced base Exp gain bonus introduced a few patches ago
 Increased enemy damage in very late game

Dashes

 Honking Phoenix (Sir Honkalot’s dash): Reduced grace time after dash 0.2 -> 0.1
 Electric Charge (Britta’s dash): range increased from 350 -> 400, damage 70 -> 100

Items

 Grand Lich’s Rib Cage: Reduced neutral resistances by 10%, increases agility penalty from -5 to -7, health multiplier now scales from 1.3 to 1.4 (from 1.5)

Talents

 Necromastery: Skeleton contact damage 40 -> 30
 Tactical Tackle: now gives 50% of your contact damage while dashing, down from 100%
 Honking Heal: reduced heal from 20% -> 15%
 Santa Claws: Increases quest amount 3 -> 4
 Epic Effect Damage: Reduced 80% -> 60%

Descriptions:

 Furcifer now mentions in the tutorial that you see your health on your character’s body and encourages dash usage

Visuals:

 Improved some talent icons
 Improved Britta’s dash
 Improved the levelup screen layout and animation
 Added a hint that the attribute you level can be chosen
 Adjusted how long text stays on screen after being fully visible based on the text length

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.9 (Demo)
notes.content:
We wish you a Happy New Year!
Over the holidays we've polished the heck out of the demo.

This patch brings a lot of visual improvements, balancing tweaks and even cool new features! 

Take a look at your inventory during a run, you can now find a damage meter there, giving you more insight into how much damage you dealt with your spells and items.
The leaderboard runcards also include a damage meter from now on.

We also added a ton of options such as the CRT effect to customize your Fungeon experience!

Here's the full changelog for 0.4.9:

New Features:

 DAMAGE METER is now shown during & after the run. It also shows for runs in the leader board
 Added retro CRT scanline shader to options
 Resistances now stack multiplicatively (50% + 50% = 75%), floor-wise reduction is removed, and resistance cap is removed
 Added options: Seasonal talents can all be enabled, disabled or seasonal. Text speed can be adjusted. Damage numbers for crits can now also be turned off.

Fixes:

 Fixed “Overwhelming Power” not increasing in size
 Block values were displayed with diminishing returns already applied, which was hard to understand. It now shows the correct (higher) amount
 Fixed sunstrike collision being flipped 90°
 Fixed a bug where bees were sometimes falsely being spawned as summons (and therefore taking damage and giving no gold)
 Fixed wands/dash in esc-menu having the interactable cursor despite not being interactable
 Fixed a crash when clicking an item on the Fungeon ticket
 Fixed trees being hit by the spikes in the miniboss room
 Fixed a tooltip remaining on screen

Balance:
General

 Increased player base movespeed by 10%
 Rescaled the enemy maximum number to be lower early game and higher late game, reduced the cast speed and movement speed of late game enemies to compensate
 Reduced tree collision size

Spells:

 Reworked Ball Lightning: damage per tick is higher, tick rate lower, the ball is smaller, bounces more and moves differently. The ball can be detonated ever 5s for an much stronger explosion.
 Shock Hands: hitbox now extends more towards the player to hit stuff below you, knockback now goes away from the player
 Poison Spray: now applies knockback away from the player instead of from the telegraph middle. Also increased knockback from 100 to 150 per tick.
 Firebolt: reduced knockback 300 -> 250

Items

 Icicle Spear: projectile now has full size earlier, cooldown 3s -> 2s, damage 70 -> 100 to compensate
 Trinkets max health modifier 25 -> 40

Talents

 Soul of the Honey Badger: now additionally reduced damage taken for 3s when dropping below 50% hp
 Phoenix Badger: now shoots a flame nova when it activates, heal increased from 35% -> 50%
 Skeleton base damage reduced from 70 to 60 
 Necromastery: bonus damage reduced from 50 to 40 (they should still deal good damage…)
 Friend Combustion: damage 75 -> 100
 Critical Zap: cooldown now is target-wise, making it much better aoe
 Evasiveness: now also triggers on block, removed cooldown. Now gives +5 agility instead of +20% movespeed
 Gold Conductor: now gives attack speed instead of dash rate, bonus 30 -> 100, duration 1s -> 0.3s

Improved Descriptions:

 Dragon Tail now mentions the number of flames
 Improved the amount of information in wand tooltips
 Added additional keywords for burn and freeze with tooltips

Visuals:

 Leaf particles now do not spawn in the tutorial
 Improved some items
 Improved Venom Spit
 Improved Sword particles
 Skeleton critical hits damage numbers are now colored red and play the crit animation
 Reduced shotgun screenshake
 Added a popup message when you are too poor to buy an item from the Fungeon Report
 Tooltips: Added an underline to highlight keywords that can be hovered for a tooltip
 Talent icons are reactively downscaled instead of spilling over their boxes
 Improved talent icon shader
 Restructured the esc menu
 Reorganized Options menu
 Improved the UI buttons
 Juiced up the leaderboard
 Hovered Leaderboard entries now respond more, added a magnifying glass icon with a hint at the run cards

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.8 (Demo)
notes.content:
In this patch, we introduce Quest talents - these talents give you a task, and a reward when you fulfill it! We added 4 Quest talents, and we'd love to hear your feedback on them!

Also, we wish you happy holidays! 

Here's the full changelog for 0.4.8:
New Features:

 Added QUEST TALENTS
 “Santa Claws” talent
 “Burning Blade” talent
 “Thunder God” talent
 “Necromastery” is now a quest

Fixes:

Fixed skeletons’ invulnerability time triggering from their timed life, making them *very* tanky
 Fixed skeletons getting 100% physical resistances from skeleTONs, it is now capped at 90%
 Fixed skeletons losing their knockback when passing through another skeleton

Balance:
General

 Increased the amount of knockback skeletons take
 Summon lifetime damage no longer is reduced by their physical resistance
 Increased skeleton base movespeed by 20%
 Reduced skeleton base HP 400 -> 350 to partially compensate for improved Necromastery

Items

 Ampere’s Gauntlets: reduced proc chance by 5%

Talents

 Necromastery: HP increase 50% -> 100%
 Shared Blood: Strength -5 -> -3
 Consume Friends: now gives 30% of the summon’s current HP instead of flat 75
 ZOP: moved behind the (completed) “Thunder God” Talent, reduced the damage from 50 + 2% to 10 + 1% (partially compensates for Thunder God)
 SkeleTONs: weight bonus 100 -> 60 (adjusted for the lower base weight)

Visuals:

 Decorated Furcifer for christmas
 Adjusted tooltip colors

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.7 (Demo)
notes.content:
You can now play with a friend in local co-op mode! 
Just plug in a controller and press Start/+. 
You can also play with a controller in Single player mode - please let us know how you like it!

But that's not all, we've also added 4 new talents, including one for each character that enhances the dash! Check out the full changelog below.


Full Changelog 0.4.7:
New Features:

 Added controller support (see Options to switch to controller)
 Added 2-player local CO-OP!
 NEW TALENT “Conflagration” spreads burn
 Reworked “Archmage” talent to emit icicles on combo
 Reworked “Instant Extinguishing Technique” talent to shoot icicles when hit by fire damage
 Reworked “Dark Mage” talent, it now spawns bone projectiles from dying enemies

Fixes:

 Fixed poison being applied to the player despite being invulnerable
 Fixed the player getting stuck in the tutorial by contacting the cactus while invulnerable from another hit
 Fixed fireball exploding twice when doing a direct hit. Damage and knockback were adjusted to compensate for this.
 Fixed termite stacking with itself
 “Entering Dungeon/Forest” text now respects when the game is paused
 Fixed a bug where the player did not get slowed when using Whirlwind or Ball Lightning

Balance:
General

 Strength: health regeneration per level 0.15HP/s -> 0.2HP/s
 Intelligence: effect damage per level 1.0% -> 1.5%
 Rebalanced player self-knockback and casting slow to feel cleaner
 Bees and Mushrooms now move a bit faster to the right to stay on the screen
 Increased exp amount in late floors (doom and onwards, scaling)
 Exp needed for level-up stopped scaling after level 40 because we thought it was unreachable...


Items

 Steel Blade: hit cooldown 0.5s -> 0.7s
 Fire Maw: now additionally gives 2/3/4 strength
 Bone Scythe: damage 60 -> 60/65/70
 Flame Sword: improved swing pattern
 Maxwell Boots: now add 1/2/3 Agility, movement speed after dash reduced by 10%
 Icicle Spear: critical damage 30/40/50 -> 25/30/35
 Scale Mail: buff now lingers 3s
 Ampere’s Gauntlets: ZAP rate 25/30/35 -> 20/22.5/25 to compensate for the extra coins dropping late game
 Tesla Buckler: block chance 10/15/20 -> 10/12.5/15
 Grand Lich’s Rib Cage: neutral resistance 30/35/40 -> 30/32.5/35
 Plate Mail: removed speed penalty. Added 5/7.5/10% block change. Increased mass scaling from 0.1 to 1.1/1.15/1.2
 Cleansing Amulet: heal now scales with character level
 Dragon Tail: damage per flame 15 -> 20

Spells

 Hellfire Ray: now does not slow after the charge is done

Talents

 Ignite: damage increased 35% -> 40% to account for Thermite no longer adding stacks from its own damage


Visuals:

 Enemies now respond more intensely to hits
 Fixed leaves not spawning in the first forest
 Dash cooldown label is now shown for a bit longer
 Player now bleeds more when taking damage
 Scythe Juggling has its own icon


Improved description texts:

 Introduced “updates” keyword with tooltip for scaling effects such as “Mage armor”

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.6 (Demo)
notes.content:
In this patch, we reworked the "Knight" talent tree and gave it its own mechanic. The "Slash" is a close combat attack that scales with your contact damage - this should make the stat way more viable. 

There are many balance changes and fixes, as always. Here's the complete changelog:

New Features:

 Added “Tactical Tackle” Talent
 Reworked the Knight talent tree, replacing stat-only talents with the SLASH, dealing your contact damage without the need to run into things (essentially 5 new talents)
 Reworked “Heavy” talent. It now gives block chance and regenerates HP on block
 Reworked “Evasiveness”. It now refreshes your dash when you take damage. (10s cd)
 Reworked Cleansing Amulet: regeneration now triggers when you are below 50% hp. It also gives 50% increased hp regen
Increased coin pickup amount now increase with floor, Reduced luck-based pickup amount from 2% to 1%. Let us know how this changes the exp you get. It *should* give roughly the same exp for high luck runs and more for low-luck runs.

Fixes:

 Tesla Buckler cooldown was not working at all
 Enemies had the same stat caps as the player, resulting in some stats not scaling in very late regions (this might need some rebalancing)
 Hopefully fixed a rare issue where the tutorial cactus died before landing, softlocking the game. We could not reproduce the issue, let us know should it still happen
 Fixed some tooltips persisting after talent pick
 Fixed tutorial slime poses
 Fixed screenshake slightly effecting your aiming
 Fixed some aiming jankiness when hellfire ray was aimed close to the player

Balance:

 Player projectiles are now much more resilient against aoe damage zones
 Strength scaling changed from 120 + 7* str -> 60 + 10*str
 Regen per strength 0.1 -> 0.15
 Player now has 10% more resistances in Doom and 20% more in Death (we reduced the reduction)
 ZOP damage from 4% current hp to 50 + 2%. ZAPs can no longer cause other ZAP effects.
 Skeletons now have an 0.5s invulnerability time after taking damage
 Skeleton base movespeed increased by 10%


Items:

 Slightly reduced the amount of speed shoes give you
 Ampere’s Gauntlets: ZAP chance 30/40/50 -> 25/30/35
 Ice Armor: shards 3 -> 9/10/11. Damage 20 -> 40. Also works on block now. Now has 5s cooldown.
 Grand Lich's Rib Cage: skeletons 2-> 3. Now also works on block. Added cooldown of 3.
 Firemaw and Flame sword: no longer add “Fire damage” tags to the talent pool
 Thor’s Hammer: 40/45/50, Electricity damage 10%/15%/20% -> 10%/12.5%/15%, the actual hammer damage is increased by 5
 Icicle Spear: projectile damage 50 -> 70
 Flame Sword: damage 50/55/60 -> 90
 Firemaw: damage 40/45/50 -> 60/65/70
 Calm Keeper: bonus attack speed 6/8/10 -> 6/7/8

Spells:

 Rainbow catcher cooldown 1.5 -> 1.0
 Throw Sword: Reduced sword turn-rate while thrown, increased charge time of “throw” to 1.3s to prevent canceling mid air
 Shock Hands: Slow 50% for 1.5s -> 25% for 1s. Player speed buff 50% → 30% for 1s
 Dashes
 Britta: dash invulnerability time after dash 0.1 -> 0.05, cooldown 2s -> 2.5s
 Wilhelm: dash cooldown 4 -> 3.5, the aoe lingers 0.1s longer now, making it easier to hit

Talents:

 Split Devastating Crits into two talents. Also reduced the extra damage to 30% and the critical damage to 35%
 Conductive Research: only worked on Electricity damage without mentioning it. It now has a 50% chance to ZAP on Electricity damage and 20% on every other type of damage
 Scythe Juggling: damage 60 -> 30 (the damage of the weapon when picked up as an item is unchanged)
 Up Your Arsenal: effect damage 40% -> 30%, now gives additional +30 contact damage
 Epic Effect Damage: 100% -> 80%
 Wet Dog: Intelligence -> 12, water damage 30% -> 10%
 Brave Bird: Strength 10 -> 12
 Character-specific talents now have a minimum level of 5, removed other restrictions
 Toughness: additionally gives +20% max hp
 Flash Friends: now requires “Precision”
 Skeleton Shields: now requires 30 block chance
 Friend Combustion: damage 60 -> 75
 Stronker Chonker: now gives 10% damage resistance

Trinkets:

 Critical rate average on trinkets 5% -> 4%, Crit damage 10% -> 8%
 Contact damage on trinkets 10 -> 20


Visuals

 Dash cooldown now shows an approximation when it is done, not the base value
 Improved starting screen artwork
 Presskit is now linked in starting screen

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.5 (Demo)
notes.content:
In this patch we introduce summoning as a game mechanic! The new items and talents allow you to summon an undead horde of skeletons!

Full Changelog 0.4.5:
New Features:

 2 new darkness ITEMS
 13 new darkness TALENTS: You can now summons skeletons!
 Agility now gives 1% attack speed, 1% movespeed, 1% dash rate instead of 0% attack speed, 2% movespeed, 2% dash rate per point
 Strength now additionally gives 3 contact damage per point
 Intelligence now gives +1% effect damage instead of 1% attack speed
 Shockhands now has a final hit launching enemies away
 Player projectiles can now pierce enemy projectiles for only a slight reduction in power. This should be huge for projectile spells late game.
 Removed the cap to basic attributes of 200, because you guys actually got there for some reason
 +1 stat pickups are now affected by the pickup range stat
 If you somehow manage to get past “THE END” (which you really should not be able to, players should die far earlier, but you guys keep breaking the game in unexpected ways), you now take increasing damage ticks that should guarantee your demise
 ESC menu now shows coins gathered in the run, instead of the total amount
 ESC now shows more stats when you hover “> Other Stats 1.0s. Slightly reduced size. Knockback 400 -> 350.
 Epic Resistances 50% -> 70%
 Epic Invulnerability 0.5 -> 0.3
 Epic Pickup Radius 100% -> 80%
 Zap damage 60 -> 40
 ZOP now deals 4% of the enemy’s current health, you guys really broke the game with that thing and I’m kinda proud of you
 Tesla Buckler now has a cooldown of 0.3s
 Conductive Research now has a target-based cooldown of 1s
 Flamesword: life steal scaling 3/4/5 -> 2/2.5/3, damage scaling 50/50/50 -> 50/55/60
 Knight: Increased projectile damage 15 -> 25, it is now shown in the tooltip. Now also gives 50% increased contact damage
 The player is now only protected against being one-shot every 5s (it was abusable with ultra-low hp life steal builds)
 Dragon Claws: life steal 0.6, 0.8, 1.0 % per stack -> 0.4/0.5/0.6. Movespeed 6/8/10 -> 5/6/7. To compensate this, stacks now deplete slower, 2s per stack -> 4s per stack
 Bone Scythe: wand damage 5%/ 10% / 15% -> int 2/4/6
 Sun Cream: fire resistance 50% -> 40%
 Floaties: water resistance 35% -> 20%
 Sneakers of Speed: movespeed 25% -> 20%
 Steel Blade: block chance 5%/7.5%/10% -> 10%/ 12.5%/15%
 Thor’s Hammer now additionally gives 10%/12.5%/15% effect damage. Its damage now scales 20/25/30 instead of always 20.
 Venom Cloud (from venom enchantments) can now only hit you once
 Fire Maw: damage 24/24/24 -> 40/45/50
 Ice Breath: damage 48 -> 60
 Calmkeeper now has a stack limit of 5
 Cooling Gloves now drop an actual mana globe (duration 5s) instead of applying the effect for (1.5s). Also removed the range limitation. Globe chances are reduced to compensate: globe chance   20/25/30-> 4/5/6
 Gun: damage 25 -> 30

Improved description texts:

 Added a “current” highlighted keyword to make clear which talents update when your stats change
 Important numbers are now highlighted in talents or items
 Elements are now colored in descriptions

Visuals

 Rare and demonic trinkets now keep their visuals consistently in the run cards

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.4 (Demo)
notes.content:
This patch brings new Electricity items and talents to Furcifer's Fungeon!
Of course, we are also improving balance and added some quality of life features.

Full Changelog 0.4.4:

New Features:

 23 NEW TALENTS:
 Epic talents requiring level 20
 ZAP-related skill tree
 Crit-related skill tree
 Also, “Electrostimulated Learning” and “Hammer Juggeling” can now actually be acquired
 3 NEW ITEMS
 NEW STAT “Effect damage” scales the damage of items and talents (Such as Thor's Hammer, Shockwaves or Ignite burn)
 Trinkets are now shown in the leaderboard! It also shows the cause of death, which items the player started with and the progress in meters.
 Leaderboard now allows you to scroll to see more entries. It can now be accessed from the title screen, too.
 Reworked ‘Poison Spray’. It is now directed, deals much more damage, and looks cooler
 Added Furcifer MEOW when you enter the fungeon
 Added trinket prefix “Decorated”, increasing effect damage by 10%
 Added trinket prefix “Devastating”, increasing critical damage by 10%

Fixes: 

 Growing Armor talent now actually works
 Attack Speed Globe pickup area was very small and could not be increased by pickup radius
 Dodge is now much more consistent
 Damage that can not kill (like poison) can no longer proc Soul of the Badger talent
 If you are out of talents (first of all, well done, it was never intended you go that far), you now have a fallback talent to choose

Balance:

 Enemy contact damage decreased, slight increase in spell damage. Snekk damage decreased.
 Reduced special charge duration (where you cannot move) by about 33%
 Face Melter (unique trinket) now gives 20% fire damage instead of 35% fire resistance
 Increased enemy power in floors Doom/Death/END - you guys have gotten way too good at this game and I am concerned
 Increased Gungeon Gun damage by 25%, fire rate by 25%, slowdown 40% -> 20% and bullet hp 40 -> 60 (makes it better for clashing with other projectiles)
 Decreased Whirlpool damage per tick 27 -> 23 
 Increased Shock Hands/Lightning Strike hitboxes close to player
 Shock Hands now always knocks away from player
 Redefined what “100% movespeed” means. 1% movespeed is now about 35% more pixels/frame. Characters’ movespeed now has a lower % value, but they move faster(!) than before. This also means more gain through items and agility. 
 Scorgebomb can now clear 2.5x more enemy projectiles
 Steel Blade now additionally gives 5/7.5/10 critical hit rate and it’s a little larger now
 Icicle Spear now shoots more often, further and gives +30 / 40 / 50 critical damage
 Bone Scythe regen -3 -> -4, damage 80 -> 60 to compensate for effect damage being applied
 Poison base damage per tick 5 -> 10
 Venom Tooth cd 1.5 -> 1.0, self knockback 150 -> 100.
 Sunstrike cooldown 2.5 -> 1.5, damage 200 -> 150, knockback 700 -> 500
 Sunstrike and Prismacysm now always knock enemies away from the player
 Slightly adjusted the exp needed for levelups around lvl 25+
 Honking Phoenix flames at the end 12 -> 10, Dash damage 100 -> 90
 Honkalot’s Paddle rotation speed reduced by 15%, paddle damage 75 -> 65, knockback 450 -> 400
 Ignite reduced from 50% to 35% to compensate that it now scales with effect damage
 STR/INT/AGI/LUCK can no longer go below 1
 Base critical damage 200% -> 150% to compensate for the option to buff it
 Firebolt cooldown 0.66s -> 0.5s , knockback 350 -> 300. Slow while casting 40% -> 20%
 Expanding Crystal cooldown 20/17.5/15 -> 15/13.5/12
 Hellfire Ray damage 45 -> 50
 Portal (Wilhelm’s dash) aoe radius 250 -> 330

Improved description texts:

 Replaced “*0.8 Damage taken” by “+0.2 Damage resistance” etc.
 Dragon Tail tooltip now shows the damage
 Platemail now mentions the buff duration

Visuals:

 Added more space for talents on levelup screen
 Leaderboard now notifies you when there is a new version available
 “Enter Fungeon” shield now reacts on hover
 Added a juice crit animation with a sound

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.3 (Demo)
notes.content:
We are back with another update bringing lots of balance tweaks and some quality of life.

From now on, scores submitted to the leaderboard have the build attached, including the talents and items you picked. Just click on entries and see what other players built!

We immensly buffed the dashes, they should be a viable offensive option now! 

Here's the complete changelog:

New Features:

 Leaderboard now shows the players builds! (not working retrospectively)
 Tumbling can no longer deal damage to the player - bouncing them into you is good for you now
 Player now starts with the Portable Lightning wand instead of Serpent Stick
 Added an option to reduce sprite size of player and enemies (visual only)
 Early floors now scroll faster
 Made items in Fungeon Report easier to click
 Talents can now be chosen using keyboard
 Furcifer rage level 4 (more enemy hp) and level 5 (more enemy damage) are now swapped

Fixes:

 Fixed the player being unable to aim when a controller was plugged in (we are working on controller support).
 Reworked how item qualities were calculated because it was really weird
 Fungeon Report now shows which weapons are upgrades from your collection
 Player now knock back enemies on contact, as they should
 Fixed softlock in tutorial
 Fixed Flourishing Mind giving 50% Bonus Intelligence, despite saying 25%
 Gun mashing is now limited to 10 times per second, this should not impact mashing, but balance the use of autoclickers a bit
 Trees now can only be hit 2 times per second, it looked weird and made weird noises

Balance:

 Sir Honkalot: increased dash distance
 Sir Honkalot: dash-flames now scale with dash damage stat
 Increased overall dash damage by A LOT
 Increase player contact damage by A LOT (also applies to items, talents, etc.)
 Britta Bootystabber: increased dash distance
 Item damage now scales with the respective elemental damage
 Increased Venom Tooth and Poison Spray damage over time
 Reduced life steal effectiveness
 Increased health per point of Strength from 5 to 7
 Toughness Talent: +50hp -> +100hp
 Scale Mail hp: 20 to 30 -> 40 to 60
 Melting Feet hp: 15 to 25 -> 30 to 50
 Floaties Trinket: hp 10 -> 40
 Rescaled Apprentice Studies from 1 int*level to 0.5 int*level + 3
 Added a basic invulnerability time after hit (it was intended to be 0.1s, it was bugged and never applied. Now it is 0.5s)
 Increased enemy damage to compensate for the invulnerability time
 Made it easier to collect stat orbs
 Shock Hands damage increased, cooldown reduced
 Increased hit rate on Bonkwaggle while reducing self-knockback, also increased swing angle, should be much better now
 Decreased paddle speed a bit but increased damage. It should be a bit less broken late game now.
 You can no longer be one-shot at full health.
 Furcifer’s meteors now scale with the overall damage increase by floor
 Scale Mail: effect threshold 35% -> 50%
 Ice Armor: movespeed -35% -> -15%
 Meditate/Tranquility: time without taking damage required 5s -> 3s
 Steel Dragon: shockwave damage 25 -> 50 and increased radius
 Pushing Your Luck: reworked, now gives +20 luck, -10 strength
 Reduced knockback done by Snekks
 Reduced cooldown and damage of fireball by 35%, keeping dps the same
 Neutral resistances are now reduced less than the other resistances. This should reduce the damage you take when running into an enemy.
 Slightly reduced the amount of trash enemies spawning
 Slightly increased coin pickup radius
 Increased enemy knockback resistance in late game
 Decreased enemy bounce-damage

Improved description texts:

 Tutorial now mentions that the dash’s cooldown is shown on the aura behind you
 Furcifer now mentions that he forgives you for stealing trinkets after a while
 Dash is now represented on the character sheet
 Strength/Intelligence/Agility/Luck tooltips updated and now actually describe the correct stats
 Weapons now show their damage amount in tooltip
 Sunstrike description is more accurate
 Ice Breath description is more accurate
 Shockwave tooltip now makes sense

Visuals:

 Added a dark aura to demonic items
 Improved paddle particle effects
 Slightly increased text speed
 Fixed a stuttering in death animation from loading the leaderboards

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.2 (Demo)
notes.content:
We have received lots of feedback for the demo!
So here's some QOL (damage numbers, health bar HUD, better descriptions and more), some bugfixes, balancing changes as well as some fresh new talents!

Here's the complete changelog:

New features:

 Added optional damage numbers (see Options)
 Added optional player health bar (see Options)
 Weapons now indicate cooldown with their brightness
 Added “Adventurer” talent
 Added “Overwhelming Power” talent
 Added “The Grind” talent
 Temporal buff globes now say what they do on pickup!
 Arrow keys now can be used for moving by default

Fixes:

 Steel Dragon should finally work
 Fixed a bug that left the paddle dealing damage when switched while charging
 Fixed broken parameters on demonic items
 Fixed a crash when the options were opened twice at the same time and then closed
 Fixed enemies being pushed by the left border
 Fixed weird aiming with the fire-laser
 Game now pauses on focus loss

Balance:

 Reduced Lightning Strike cooldown
 Reduced the requirements for “Steel Dragon” from 2 neutral items to only 1
 Slightly nerfed Bone Scythe
 Sir Honkalot now has more invincibility after dashing, allowing offensive dashes
 Rebalanced heart pickup to heal a bit less early and a bit more late game
 Mage armor: 1% block for 3 int -> 1% block for 4 int, it should still be good
 Ruby shield block scaling from 10%/15%/20% -> 10%/12.5%/15%
 Swarmer enemies (mushrooms and bees) move slower but have more hp, this should offer a bit more space to dodge. Also adjusted how they move close to the player.
 Stronker Chonker 4hp/s -> 3hp/s

Improved description texts

 Spell damage (now “Wand damage”)
 Block stat
 Contact damage stat
 Dragon Claws item
 Renamed “Dash cast rate” -> “Dash rate”
 Renamed the neutral element: “Physical damage” -> “Neutral damage” “None item” -> “Neutral item”
